method: Compared all48 turn decisions and complete rendered answers/citations/links with the previous reviewed native report. Exactly four previously incomplete positives changed; manually reviewed every required useful claim and full source witness for those four. The other44 replies, including all12 boundaries and the qualified Ariana alternative, are identical. Frozen oracles unchanged.
qualification: Observed regression conversations, not unseen evaluation. One useful claim uses an alternative literal guide helper and has a stated judgment qualification. Strict checks retain that failure. No zero-error claim beyond these reviewed turns. Boundary success does not establish ideal clarification wording for current-machine questions.
